archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with User's Confident Gradient (Purple to Teal)

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter text-slate-900
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

confident_mode.description: Bold, high-contrast, visually engaging. Used for public-facing and positive reinforcement screens.
rules: Use bg-brand-gradient heavily for heroes, CTA bands, and primary buttons.
Cards should use the 'card-bold' styling (gradient borders or vibrant tops).
Use script accent font for empathetic, encouraging callouts (e.g., 'Start Building Better').

grounded_mode.description: Calm, structured, minimal cognitive load. Used when users are emotionally activated.
rules: Strip out gradients. Base background must be solid --background (slate-50 or white).
Use --primary (Deep royal purple) ONLY as an accent (e.g., active state, single button, thin border).
DO NOT use teal or vibrant accents—keep it neutral and grounded.
Safety alerts MUST use --destructive (Red) to contrast heavily against the calm background.

marketing_landing.structure: Gradient hero -> Lifestyle photo band -> Icon-card grid -> Curved dividers -> CTA band
marketing_landing.details: Hero uses `bg-brand-gradient text-white`. Use sweeping curve SVG at the bottom of sections. Icon cards use white background with icons in accent-colored circles.

auth.structure: Split-card on desktop, full-bleed gradient on mobile
auth.details: Left side has lifestyle photography or gradient with tagline. Right side is the Shadcn form inside a clean white or glassmorphic container.

dashboard.structure: Gradient header band -> Progress Card -> Recent Activity -> CTA
dashboard.details: Header uses `bg-brand-gradient` welcoming the user. Cards use `card-bold` variants.

wizard_step.structure: Simple top nav (AppShell) -> Progress bar -> Question/Form -> Primary Button
wizard_step.details: Uses Grounded Mode. Background `bg-slate-50`. Soft cards (`card-soft`). High contrast for form inputs. No harsh borders.

reflection_breathing.details: Gradient reduced to subtle background only (or pale neutral). Breathing circle uses soft solid primary color ring, expanding and contracting smoothly.

summary.structure: Long-form readable -> Sticky bottom action bar
summary.details: Clear typography, standard readable measure (max-w-2xl). Sticky actions for Download/Share to ensure easy access.

button_primary.confident: bg-brand-gradient text-white active:scale-95 transition-transform rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold shadow-md (NOTE: use active:scale-95 for mobile/PWA touch feedback over hover)
button_primary.grounded: bg-primary text-primary-foreground active:scale-95 transition-transform rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold shadow-sm

cards.card_soft: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] p-6
cards.card_bold: relative bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-lg border-2 border-transparent bg-clip-padding before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-10 before:rounded-2xl before:bg-brand-gradient before:-m-[2px]

icon_circle.base: flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-full text-white

component_restyles.inputs: bg-white border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent text-base p-4

brand_mark: An SVG mark consisting of two overlapping abstract speech bubbles or soft rounded shapes forming a subtle heart. Left side deep royal purple, right side teal. Text 'SACOParents' in Plus Jakarta Sans (SACO extra bold, Parents medium).

motion.touch_feedback: active:scale-95 on all interactive elements (Critical for PWA/Capacitor feeling native)
motion.breathing_exercise: scale-100 to scale-150 over 4s (inhale), hold 7s, scale back over 8s (exhale). Smooth ease-in-out.

hero_background.description: Family standing in a field at sunset silhouette

marketing_lifestyle.description: Joyful family moment with parents and child playing on the couch indoors

calm_nature_background.description: Abstract close-up of blue and pink sea for reflection/breathing screens

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL text/background color contrast passes WCAG AA. Red alerts against white, white text on primary purple.
Do NOT rewrite entire structural logic. Add custom classes and adjust component styles via Tailwind variables.
Add 'Plus Jakarta Sans' and 'Caveat' to index.html/Google Fonts import or Next.js fonts config.
Map all colors to Tailwind config by extending theme colors with CSS variables (e.g., `colors: { primary: 'hsl(var(--primary))' }`).
Implement the 'Two Modes' logic contextually. Grounded mode should NOT have any teal or vibrant magenta, keeping users in a safe, unactivated emotional state.
Respect PWA/Mobile wrappers: use `active:scale-95` instead of just hover states for touch feedback.
Do not destroy existing functionality in AppShell, BiometricGate, BreathingExercise, or SafetyAlert. Apply class swaps to match the new design.
